source: The original /v2.0/data/occurrences?taxonname=... response ignored a non-existing taxon name; do not use this endpoint to claim species-level fossils.
validation: Taxon-specific /taxa/{taxonid}/occurrences path must return different occurrence IDs or a confirmed zero outcome; repeated generic query hashes invalid evidence
Age fields are extracted with field paths and raw source values, not misread as independently calibrated species-level 21ka fossils
Do not filter periods unless a sample-level age model and calibration source are independently verified
Pollen at genus only may not identify exact species even when matched to valid Neotoma taxon ID
Source 20-row pages do not support absence inference and fail on missing chronology/site geometry
Do not change existing negative host vs unrelated botanical glacial climate conclusions; no insect genotypes opened
